services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: When you book a birthday party with us, we provide full use of the facilities, a private room for you and your guests, and someone who will assist with set up and clean up if needed. For every 4 children, 1 adult must be present at the party. All food and beverages must be kept in the designated party room. You provide the following: paper products (paper plates, paper cups, etc.); plastic silverware, tablecloths (up to three); cake knife if needed; refreshments, and decorations. (Please do not adhere or tack anything to the walls, doors, or windows.) In addition, please DO NOT bring latex balloons or peanut products into the museum. Please review the museum rules before scheduling parties.
